decision: Keep the simple baseline; do not fit or deploy this prototype.
scope: Private os30 experiment; immutable native models and app revisions. Production sources, sibling deployments and SD card unchanged.
implemented: Immutable raw-vertex snapshot runs queued in the existing ingress ring; no CPU preflight-result poll or returned keep-mask compaction.
Shared exact culler and conversion emit ordinary vertex/draw packets into an independent BRAM FIFO.
Snapshot lifetime ends after conversion and ordered explicit release, before raster consumption; supported runs overlap later CPU work.
Conservative hardware admission metadata; exact CPU arithmetic-only repair from retained operands, with caller FCSR preservation.
Raw vertex LOAD completion remains synchronous. CPU still performs display-list admission/context setup and unsupported paths.

verification.native: Every candidate passes exact color/depth, all physical color-buffer history, surface pool, FP/FCSR and architectural registers except the known time register; 1708 indexed draws preserve referenced values and load-time projection/draw-time state.
verification.units: Actual metadata, shared-FMA/reset, FIFO/order/wrap/repair, extracted C admission, lazy materialization and actual CPU repair passed. Separate 2048-word FIFO pressure/wrap suite passes.
verification.fixture_fix: Initial queued-v1 run is excluded: legacy snapshot restoration incorrectly conflated the independent ingress/output pointers. replay_v2/v3 preserve the drained output pointer and restore only ingress; zero host clock edges added.
verification.observer_caveat: v1-driver legacy ring occupancy combines distinct pointers and is not used for QGF pressure conclusions; v3 observer fixes it. Static legacy poll-PC attribution is not used for conclusions.

findings.fifo_effect: 2048 rather than 512 words recovers 34415 warm cycles, but only returns to baseline.
findings.main_costs: Admission/context/publication and retained CPU paths offset reduced CPU cull/vertex-packet work. FIFO backpressure limits eligible coverage; exact FMA request arbitration is only about 3000 warm cycles.
findings.memory_limit: This does not rule out all CPU/GPU memory bottlenecks. It rules out claiming a frame-speed improvement from this geometry queue or faster snapshot copying on these intervals.

physical.512_stage: Four spare M10Ks are nominally allocated to snapshots and output FIFO; ALM fit/timing unqualified.
physical.2048_counterfactual: Existing 4096-word ingress retained; larger FIFO is a capacity experiment, not a fitted design. Repartitioning ingress BRAM was considered and not implemented because this only ties baseline.

limitations: Two fixed native SM64 intervals with synthetic display/audio traffic and bounded guest services; no sustained hardware FPS claim.
Conservative admitted opaque/current-generation path only; clipping/equal-W/unsupported materials use existing CPU path.
No fully asynchronous raw LOAD implementation or second CPU.
